Content: New research comparing the anatomy and behavior of dogs and wolves found that dogs have small facial muscles around their eyes which allow them to raise their inner eyebrow. This makes their eyes appear larger and more infant-like. Wolves do not have these muscles.
Scientists hypothesize that dogs expressing this “puppy-dog eye” trait unconsciously stimulate a desire in humans to take care of them.
